w: The satsang mandal of a village came to meet Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Because of harassment by one community in the village, the villagers had united and decided to cut off relations and dealings with them. Some practical people did not like this harshness. On this point alone a battle broke out among them, and they even stopped going to each other's weddings and other occasions. All of them had come together to Swamishri today. Swamishri said to these men, "The people of the community for whom you did this are sitting on one side, and disunity has entered among you. The constant meeting and mixing within families has gone and trouble has come in. Unity has gone. You have lost more than you gained. This is something to understand. Because of disunity the development of the village will also stop. Because if something good is happening for the first group, the second will block it, and if it is happening for the second, the first will. In this way a third party will take advantage of the disunity between you two. It is a matter of letting go of just a little. If you let go, there will be peace."

By filling the widening crack, Swamishri saved the village's development and peace, which were being ground into the dust. Not only for the people of that village, but for every family and community, these words of Swamishri are like a motto for success.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj meets President Bill Clinton. ( See special report )

st.t: National and International News of BAPS - Pramukh Swami Maharaj Meets President Bill Clinton
w: President Clinton marvels at the rosary presented to him by Swamishri. He is impressed by Swamishri's faith in the power of prayer to promote world peace Download high resolution file
To emphasize this message of world peace, Pramukh Swami Maharaj met the President of the United States of America, Bill Clinton.

His Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj, the spiritual leader of the worldwide socio-spiritual organization, Bochasanwasi Shree Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Sanstha (BAPS), is highly respected in the Hindu faith for his saintliness and his efforts to promote world peace. In the recently held "Millennium World Peace Summit" at the United Nations in New York, Pramukh Swami Maharaj's message gave fresh hope for all seekers of peace and harmony in the world.
The President was in Miami on official business. Swamishri was also in Miami to lay the foundation stone for a new BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir.

This historic meeting took place on Wednesday, October 4, 2000 at the Biltmore Hotel in Miami, Florida, where the two prominent leaders greeted each other warmly. The President was informed of Lord Swaminarayan's life and work and given details of numerous humanitarian, spiritual, cultural, educational, environmental and medical activities conducted worldwide by BAPS under the leadership of Pramukh Swami Maharaj.
The President was very impressed by the scope and depth of the activities of BAPS and the virtuous personality of Pramukh Swami Maharaj.

During their discussion about world peace, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Our body represents the whole world. If any part of our body is injured, it causes pain all over the body. Similarly, if there is violent activity in any corner of the world, it causes pain everywhere and leads to difficulties. To prevent such unrest, we chant the rosary and pray to God. And if politicians and diplomats, like yourself, meet to seek initiatives then peace will be established in the world."
With this, Pramukh Swami Maharaj blessed the President that his attempts to restore peace in the Middle East be successful.

Grateful to receive Pramukh Swami Maharaj's blessings, the President said, "I am deeply honored and happy that You Holiness has visited our country. I spend most of my time resolving differences between people. In this way, our work is similar! I pray for your wisdom in guiding us towards peace and happiness."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj then presented the President with an "Amrut Kalash" - a decorative, golden urn symbolizing the auspiciousness of Indian culture - and a rosary, which the President touched to his heart in reverence.

Welcome Assembly & Annakut Swamishri arrived in Dar-es-Salaam by plane from Kampala at 11.40 am. In the evening, a welcome assembly was held at Lakshminarayan Mandir, in which senior devotees and local leaders garlanded Swamishri.

Sharad Purnima Celebration: The day marked the 75th inaugural anniversary of Gondal Mandir, the 225th birthday celebration of Gunatitanand Swami and the bicentenary year of Gunatitanand Swami’s diksha . The grand celebration was held in the mandir precincts where more than 29,000 devotees participated. Despite ill health Swamishri attended the celebration assembly. The programme included speeches, dance and dramas:

Speech: Purpose of Gunatitanand Swami’s birth – Pujya Shrihari Swami Drama: “Gunatitanand Swami’s Saintliness” Speech: History of Gondal Mandir – Pujya Siddheshwar Swami Drama: “Pandade Pandade Maharaj and Swami” Speech: Difficulties during Gondal Mandir construction – Pujya Adarshjivan Swami Drama: Shastriji Maharaj plays dilruba Video: Yogiji Maharaj Speech: Reminiscences of Yogiji Maharaj in Gondal – Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami Traditional Dance: Local youths Speech: Memories about Pramukh Swami Maharaj in Gondal – Pujya Viveksagar Swami Blessings: Swamishri Swamishri said, “Shriji Maharaj took birth on earth to liberate countless souls. He brought Gunatitanand Swami with him. The reference of Akshar is found in Vachanamrut Gadhada I-71. By offering bhakti to God along with the Gunatit Sadhu one’s inner weaknesses and failings are dissolved in this birth instead of 100 births. This was the reason why Shastriji Maharaj had installed the murti of Gunatitanand Swami.” The assembly programme was interspersed with five artis performed by devotees, senior sadhus and Swamishri.
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of murtis for BAPS hari mandirs in Mombasa (Kenya), Karjan and a suburb of Mahesana.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj was walking. Dharmasetu Swami, sitting in front, said, "There are so many problems in the world, and some of them are because of people's natures. This satsang is divine and like a chintamani (wish fulfilling jewel), but even in it there are problems because of natures and faults. But Gunatitanand Swami wrote, 'If God and the Sant cast one glance, everything is resolved.' You have come into this world to make everyone happy, so I have thought of a remedy that will benefit you as well as us, and that remedy is your glance. Casting a glance will not be any trouble for you at all. At present your whole day goes in resolving the problems of devotees and everyone. Isn't that true?"
Hearing what Dharmasetu Swami said, Swamishri kept smiling.
So Dharmasetu Swami said, "Try an experiment on all of us sitting here right now. Cast your glance right now, so that you have peace and we have peace too."

Swamishri said, "It is because this experiment was done that you have come here. Leaving the comforts there (in America) and coming here, does that happen just like that? You have understood this, and you have understood that God and the Sant are the gateway to moksha, so you have come here, and if you understand that much, the work is done. Through katha and spiritual talks this will be understood. You left all those good comforts and came, and you have understood that this happiness is greater than those, haven't you!"
Dharmasetu Swami said, "But if you cast your glance, there is benefit on both sides."

Swamishri said, "I have cast my glance! That is why you came! It was Yogiji Maharaj's wish to make educated sadhus. So all of you were drawn here, and now he himself will make you brahmarup. You do understand who Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj were! You have come to this college, so now by the grace of God and the Sant everything will be done."
Dharmasetu Swami put it in many different ways many times, but Swamishri held on to just one point: the spiritual effort is something we ourselves have to do.

ds.t: Admission to the college of Brahmavidya
w: Today, after the shangar arti, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was going towards the car, the hostel youths said, "Oho...! The principal of the college of Brahmavidya has come. Swami! You will give us admission to your college of Brahmavidya, won't you?"
"If you keep a sense of faultlessness towards all, you will get admission." Swamishri stated the qualification for entry into the college of liberation.
While coming out of the mandir, Mahant Swami Maharaj said to Pranavtirthdas Swami, who was standing near Ghanshyam Maharaj's room, "Where were you yesterday? You were not at this spot."
Brimming with joy, Pranavtirthdas Swami said, "Swamishri has noticed that I stand at this spot every day!"
Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the Vadil Din (Elders' Day) assembly. Narayanmunidas Swami, who was conducting it, began a question and answer session with Swamishri on behalf of the elders.
Question: "Now we are 65 years old or more, so what should we do at this age?"

Guiding them, Swamishri said, "Subramaniam Saheb had asked Pramukh Swami Maharaj, 'What is your next project?' Then Pramukh Swami Maharaj had replied, 'Bhajan and bhakti (worship and devotion), of course. Akshardham and everything else are included within it.' We are satsangis, so this is what we have to do."
Question: "All our lives we have worked with attachment, so we keep worrying about the family. What thought should we keep about this?"

Swamishri said, "This very thing. Maharaj said: we have had endless relatives over endless births, but we do not remember them. In the same way, these too will be forgotten. The final knowledge is: who is family? That has to be applied. With such knowledge, remain detached."
Question: "What should we do so that unity and harmony remain in the family?"

Swamishri said, "That should remain. Pramukh Swami Maharaj said: what is the permanent project? Bhajan and bhakti. That should remain in our minds. Then let the sons and daughters do as they do. Insist mainly that they practise Satsang. As for money and all that, a millionaire today can be on the street tomorrow. So pray that they practise Satsang. Turn the mala."
Question: "What should we do when we see odd natures in the family?"

Swamishri smiled and said, "Tolerate, because if we cannot change our own natures, how will we change other people's? If ours have been removed, there is stability, and if not, problems arise. Even if what you say is right, and you have experience and he does not, let him do it. All problems are of natures. Come straight to yourself. See what your own natures are like. Akshardham is beyond natures. So this is how it will have to be done."
Question: "When we tolerate, we tolerate with a heavy heart. But what should we do so that there is joy and stability even in tolerating?"

Swamishri said, "We have attained a God as great as the Himalayas! And against that, natures and problems are like clods of earth. So if we understand the glory of God, natures and everything else will be dropped. We say Maharaj is beyond, but 11 is also said to be beyond 10. 100 is also beyond 10. 1,000 is also beyond 10. A billion is also beyond 10. But Maharaj is infinitely beyond. Maharaj said, 'Even I cannot reach the limit of my own glory.' If such glory is understood, nothing will remain standing. Everything will evaporate and be burnt to ashes."
Swamishri taught the elders the elixir for living life.
